title: Semantic HTML Tags You Should Be Using
intro: Semantic tags describe what content is, not just how it looks. They help screen readers, search engines and your teammates.

slides.heading: Page structure
slides.subtitle: Tags that outline the page.
points: <header> for the top of a page or section

slides.heading: Content tags
slides.subtitle: Group related content.
points: <section> for a themed group of content

slides.heading: Why it matters
slides.subtitle: More than tidy code.
points: Screen readers can jump between landmarks
Search engines understand your page better
Code is easier to read and maintain

slides.heading: Avoid div soup
slides.subtitle: Use a div only when nothing else fits.
points: Headings in order: h1, then h2, then h3

cta: Be honest: how many divs are in your last project?
